title: Get your first agent running
subtitle: Four steps to have an agent working with your data. You can skip any of them and come back whenever you want.

describe.title: What do you want to solve?
describe.body: Describe the problem in your own words: who has it, which data is involved and what should happen. We will use it to prepare the Composer.
describe.label: Your case
describe.placeholder: For example: we receive 300 emails a day with questions about invoices and want to answer them using our terms, asking for approval before issuing credit notes.
examples: Answer customers about their invoices using our terms and ask for approval before issuing credit notes over €500.
Qualify the leads that arrive through the website, record them in the CRM and reply by email in under five minutes.
Extract supplier invoice data into a table and have a person validate unclear cases.
An internal assistant that answers employees about holidays, leave and the collective agreement.
describe.required: Write at least one sentence or skip this step.

template.title: Pick a template or describe your case to the Composer
template.body: Templates come with agents, workflows, sample data and evals ready. The Composer builds a tailored solution from your description.
template.templateBody: Eight complete industry solutions you can adapt to your data.
template.composerBody: It will ask a few questions, propose a plan and build it once you approve it.
template.composerBodyWithGoal: We will open the Composer with what you wrote in the previous step.

data.title: Connect a data source or upload files
data.body: Agents answer better with your documents and tables. Files are chunked and indexed automatically.
data.uploadBody: PDF, Word, Excel or CSV into a knowledge base.
data.connectBody: Google Drive, SharePoint, your database, your CRM and more, with sync.
data.doneBody: Your data is already in Messer.

test.title: Test your agent
test.body: Open the agent in the Studio and ask it real questions in the test chat. Every answer is traced with its calls, tokens and cost.
test.noAgent: You don't have any agent yet. Create a project from a template or with the Composer and come back to this step.
test.doneBody: Your agent has completed its first run. The next step is deploying it to production.
